title: Station location annotations from retained GeoNames, CLDR and native source geography
status: Committed data sidecar; no native-format, SDK/runtime, site or release integration implied.

sidecar.format: UTF-8 JSON Lines, one object per native station_id
sidecar.copy_policy: Byte-identical copy of the accepted full measurement; no reprocessing.

native.cohort_rule: Every station record in the pinned native candidate, with no country, status or prediction-quality exclusions.
native.release_status: Unreleased candidate; this sidecar does not approve publication or release.

approved_predicate.rule: All required station IDs have a machine-readable location annotation: nearest same-country city within 40 km; otherwise sourced admin1 plus canonical country name, else country name alone; AQ Antarctica; unresolved country candidates shown together as explicitly unresolved region, or explicit unresolved region when none exist. Region-level fallbacks do not assert a locality or jurisdiction.
approved_predicate.comparison_limit: TIE records complete annotation availability under this dated owner-approved rule. It is not a result for the earlier strict locality/region/country requirement or an SDK rendering comparison.

fields.station_id: Exact native station identity. Join by this value; sidecar row order is not a public identifier.
fields.label: Display annotation. Its specificity and uncertainty are carried by label_level, method and resolved_jurisdiction; do not treat every label as a locality.
fields.label_level: locality means nearest same-country city within40km; region includes source-bound admin1, country-only, Antarctica and explicitly unresolved regional context.
fields.resolved_jurisdiction: False on all delivered rows. A proximity or source-derived display label does not establish station jurisdiction.
fields.country_code: Unchanged native country value, normally a three-letter code; null remains null for unresolved country. No jurisdiction is selected from city proximity.
fields.country_name: Canonical English CLDR display name for the existing native country code; null remains null when unresolved. Native source territory names/aliases are not rewritten.
fields.locality: Present only for a selected GeoNames city within40km in the same source-bound country. This is nearby-city context, not a verified station address.
fields.method: Explicit choice among the five approved methods listed below.
fields.country_candidates: For unresolved country, all retained sourced country candidates with their existing codes and display names; no candidate is preferred.
fields.source_binding: Object for resolved source inputs, or array retaining all unresolved source bindings. Carries native field/value or source/source_record_id, GeoNames IDs/coordinates/country/admin1/distance, or CLDR territory/subdivision identifiers. Source metadata is evidence, not a station-jurisdiction assertion.

methods.nearest_same_country_city_within_40km: Nearest retained GeoNames cities500 record in the native country, with measured great-circle distance <=40km. The GeoNames admin1 describes that city; it is not used to infer station admin1.
methods.source_bound_admin1_region: Outside the city rule, use an existing source-bound native region_code with its matching CLDR subdivision name and canonical country name.
methods.country_only_region: If no sourced admin1 binding exists, use the existing country code and canonical CLDR country name only.
methods.antarctica_region: Native ATA maps to CLDR AQ and displays Antarctica. No city, research-base or jurisdiction inference.
methods.unresolved_country_region: Retain all sourced candidates together in an explicitly unresolved region label; if none exist, use an explicit unresolved region label. No forced country or jurisdiction choice.

source_inputs.pin_semantics: SHA256 pins identify the exact retained inputs. CLDR URLs are commit-pinned; GeoNames download URLs are mutable upstream locations whose captured bytes are pinned here. Listed source inputs are attribution/provenance references, not additional files bundled in this directory.

geonames.attribution: Location annotations derived from GeoNames, https://www.geonames.org/, licensed under Creative Commons Attribution4.0 International.
geonames.changes: Selected nearest same-country city records within40km and combined names with source-bound native geography and CLDR display names; derived annotations retain source IDs and distances.

licenses_and_attribution.native: Existing native source records, territory/country aliases, source licences and attribution remain unchanged. This sidecar does not grant new permissions for the native dataset.

historical_no_go.predicate: Strict nearest same-country locality within40km, including the AQ-only research-base proposal.
historical_no_go.witness: Rae Island OTC-0012a4f2: nearest same-country city Tuktoyaktuk81.72686551048034km away, beyond40km. The delivered label is Canada, not Tuktoyaktuk or inferred Northwest Territories.

historical_no_go.predicate: Region fallback requiring a unique country.
historical_no_go.witness: Phipi Reef OTC-1f91a5ad has retained PNG and AUS candidates. The approved dated rule labels them together as unresolved; it does not resolve jurisdiction.

limitations: Historical strict NO_GO results remain valid under their earlier predicates; no retrospective strict-locality pass is claimed.
Region-level labels are not localities. All resolved_jurisdiction flags remain false; unresolved source candidates are preserved.
No nearest-city administrative-region inference beyond40km is applied.
The sidecar is actual machine-readable data joined by station_id. SDK/native-reader consumption, runtime display, accuracy, site publication and release are outside this delivery.
